prompt_text: What is the best Airbnb or short term rental to book in Nashville for a family of four?
answer_verbatim:
For a family of four, I’d start with a **2-bedroom, 2-bath rental in East Nashville**: it gives everyone more room and a quieter home base than staying right on Broadway, while keeping downtown a short drive or rideshare away.

One promising option from the listings I found is **“Great Location! Trendy East Nashville. 2 Bed and 2 Bath, close to downtown!”** on Vrbo. It’s listed for up to six guests and has a **10/10 rating from 379 reviews**. [View the listing](https://www.vrbo.com/vacation-rentals/usa/tennessee/middle/nashville/east-nashville)

If being able to walk to downtown attractions matters more, look at Airbnb’s **“Walk to Broadway! 2BR/2BA Modern Condo + Parking”**—it advertises two queen beds, twin bunks, two bathrooms, and parking. [Browse Nashville Airbnb condos](https://www.airbnb.ca/nashville-tn/stays/condos)

The best choice depends on your dates, budget, and whether you’ll have a car; availability and total prices can change substantially. Share those details—and the children’s ages, if relevant—and I can narrow it down.
